0022600181.text: The Timberwolves (5-3, 8th in the West, 1 game back in the Northwest) visit the 7-1 Rockets, who lead the West and the Southwest and are on a two-game winning streak, in Minnesota's ninth game of the season, where they carry a one-game winning streak into the matchup. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), and Terrence Shannon Jr. is day-to-day with a hip bruise and a game-time decision, while Houston is without Steven Adams (calf strain) and Clint Capela is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Timberwolves won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 136-132 road win in Houston on April 10, 2026.
